title: CJ V Probable NDE 6334
content: I had a problem pregnancy. I was in the hospital with premature labor and was hooked up to a drug to delay labor until the baby developed further. Unfortunately, I wound up being rushed into surgery for an emergency cesarean section. After surgery, I could feel I was fading. The anesthesiologist at one point put something under my nose to bring me back. I remember being wheeled into another room. My sister said she was in there and they tried to get her out of the room when they were losing me. She told them if I was going to die, I would die holding her hand. I was not conscious during that time; I don't remember anything until the experience. I remember all my surroundings were purely white and very soft feeling in my mind. I was in such peace I just wanted to stand there; I was in no pain at all. The feeling of comfort is almost indescribable. Then, I looked and my mother, who had passed away about ten years earlier, was standing a distance away from me, like maybe 10 yards, but directly in front of me. She was also in white; her hair was as I remember it when she was a young woman from her pictures. She had a firm, mother firm, look on her face and she said 'Go back CJ, it's not time yet'. I remember the feeling of disappointment rushing over me: not wanting to go, but the next thing I knew I was awake with people around me talking. I remember how sad I felt. The pain my body was in hit me hard. I was quite sick with a fever and infection. When I told them in the room that I had seen mom, they said it was because of my fever. I know better and no one can convince me otherwise. Since then I have had experiences of spirits living with me. After research I found out my awareness was enhanced because of the near-death experience.

environment.environment_other_detail: Surroundings were described as "purely white" and "very soft feeling".

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency cesarean section after premature labor; felt she was "fading" after surgery and was not conscious for a period.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; experience begins in a white peaceful environment, then encounter with deceased mother who instructs her to return, followed by awakening in the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported later "experiences of spirits living with me" and that research suggested her awareness was "enhanced" after the NDE.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Mother said: 'Go back CJ, it's not time yet'.
